html_source: 1898 cartoon by French satirist Caran d'Ache (pseudonym of Emmanuel Poiré) in the antisemitic weekly cartoon magazine Psst...! that he co-founded, showing a family dinner ruined by discussion of the Dreyfus affair. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
